name: Riddle Quiz Maker
description: Riddle is a quiz marketing platform with built-in lead generation forms. In addition to quizzes you can also create polls, survey, personality tests, interactive stories and more.

events.d: Check whether an AI-generated Riddle is still pending, completed or failed.
List, search and filter Riddles in your account or a project, or get one Riddle by ID.
Change the title of a Riddle.
Create a quiz, poll or personality test with the Riddle AI from a topic or a web page.
Take a Riddle offline so its public URL is no longer reachable.
Get the HTML embed code of a published Riddle for your website or CMS.
Get a QR code image of a published Riddle for print material.
Attach an existing tag or a new tag to a Riddle.
Remove a tag from a Riddle.
Get leads from all your Riddles or one chosen Riddle, with date, search and completion filters.
Get views, starts, time spent and answer breakdown for a Riddle.
Delete a Riddle that was built via the API or the Riddle AI.
Runs when a new Riddle is created in your account, optionally filtered by type.
